label: last original token y (or <DEL>) in L=9 sequences starting with g
explanation: Extremely sparse (29 activations on 26 of 1M sequences). Nearly all activations are at the end of the original phase (final original token, t=8) or at the <DEL> step, in long sequences (L=9 carries 96% of mass) whose first token is g (98% of mass). The final original token is usually y (80% of mass); the max activation (3.2) is on a final y. Never fires during the copy phase. Even the tightest predicate (L=9, last original token, first token g, input y) has precision of only ~4% on dev, so the conditions are necessary-ish but far from sufficient; too few examples to characterize further.
